sampling.transfer_rule: Within each window, unavailable stable quota transfers to sensitive, then unavailable sensitive quota transfers to stable; remaining capacity is filled stable then sensitive. Remaining per-window deficits receive fixed-seed groups from other windows with unused unique groups. If the global unique-group pool is below 60, the shortfall is reported and groups are never duplicated. Visual content never enters selection.

boundary: Development train/validation frames only. Sampling uses candidate geometry and a fixed seed, never visual judgment or annotations. Empty human fields are not labels. No image is imported into training. Geometry review is not detection or classification accuracy evidence.
